commits.message:
fix(url-handler): the lost-click notice is one entry that stays listed, under the product's name

High review of PR #600. The notice keeps a Notification Center entry after
the banner expires, a run of lost clicks replaces one notice instead of
stacking copies, and the authorization prompt names cc-candybar via
CFBundleDisplayName instead of the bundle name. The authorization comment
states only what the API documents, and the single-enforcer marker sits
in the sentence it governs.

feat(url-handler): a click the forwarder could not deliver tells the user (candybar-daemon-health-ajx0.c3x)

The forwarder's one visible failure, a frame it could not write, is now
also a macOS user notification whose body is the observed error (the
connect failure, or the bounded write wait), never a diagnosis. The
delivered arm is untouched, so a slow click that landed cannot look lost.
Authorization is requested on every lost click (idempotent, no state);
a denied or failed post is logged under the app's subsystem.

The app is frontmost when it posts, because Launch Services activates it
to deliver the click, and macOS hides a frontmost app's notifications
unless its delegate presents them; the delegate asks for the banner.

Decided on the ticket: no launcher beside the socket, the forwarder
never starts a daemon.

fix(launch): a launch's input outlives its direct child for the descendants that read it (candybar-testing-0x6u.3zo) (#598)

* fix(launch): a launch's input outlives its direct child for the descendants that read it (candybar-testing-0x6u.3zo)

* fix(launch): a held input shares the drains' one hold, metered and free of the launch's scope (candybar-testing-0x6u.3zo)

* fix(launch): feed takes the input's Buffer form too (candybar-testing-0x6u.3zo)

* fix(launch): a held input's end is built outside the launch, and its tests count the input (candybar-testing-0x6u.3zo)

* fix(launch): the input's exception marks the swallowed error, and the close test holds its input unread (candybar-testing-0x6u.3zo)

* fix(test): the descendant reads its input through an fd dash leaves alone (candybar-testing-0x6u.3zo)
